title: Characterizing the General Subkey-Rank Distribution
summary: Guessing entropy gives only the expected subkey rank, while the distinguishing-vector distribution tends to a multivariate Gaussian; the full rank distribution remains to be characterized.

formal_statement.body: Open problem. In a side-channel evaluation, consider the subkey-rank random variable associated with a distinguishing vector; its expectation is the subkey guessing entropy. Characterize the full probability distribution of this rank in general, rather than only its expectation. Although the distinguishing-vector distribution tends to a multivariate Gaussian, the subkey-rank distribution itself remains insufficiently understood.

scope.domain: Side-channel cryptanalysis of subkey-rank distributions associated with distinguishing vectors.
scope.unresolved_remainder: A general characterization of the full subkey-rank probability distribution beyond its expectation.

citations.label: Characterisation and Estimation of the Key Rank Distribution in the Context of Side Channel Evaluations

progress.summary: The source presents subkey guessing entropy as the expected subkey rank and notes that the distinguishing-vector distribution tends to a multivariate Gaussian. It identifies the general subkey-rank distribution as insufficiently explored.
citation_labels: Daniel P. Martin et al., Characterisation and Estimation of the Key Rank Distribution in the Context of Side Channel Evaluations
